reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model AD10004LS, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The claimed purchase date of 2023-03-27 is before the program's sale window of 2023-04-01 to 2024-08-31, so the purchase is not eligible for a refund.
The retailer, Amazon.com, is on the listed sellers, but that does not cure the out-of-window purchase date.
No other claims share a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this claim, so no flag applies.
